item.title: Lake Biwa Watersports: SUP, Kayak, Sailing and Windsurfing — Guide
item.description: Lake Biwa is Kansai’s great freshwater playground, big enough to offer serious watersports without the salt, chop and tides of the sea. Its calm mornings are made for stand-up paddleboarding and kayaking, gliding over water so clear along the western and northern shores that you can watch fish beneath the board, while the reliable afternoon winds funnelling down the lake turn beaches like Omi-Maiko and Omi-Shirahama into busy sailing and windsurfing centres.
